hypothesis: If bird/tag/roost micro-geography alone produces apparent bird identity in daily-centered GPS altitude distributions, low-motion source fixes from the SAME birds at the SAME 5km grain may retain a similar held-out individual identity signal even when flight movement is absent.

source.original_source_study: Eurasian griffon vulture in France (Grands Causses 2018) ID_PROG 961

negative_control_prescreen.movement_class: Native ground-speed 0.0 to 1.0 m/s inclusive. This is a LOW-MOTION PROXY, NOT verified stationary/on-ground state (GPS speed and bird kinematics may include slow flapping, gliding or drift).
negative_control_prescreen.exclude_test_device: Always exclude source individual-local-identifier 'Test géodésie ornitela' and any other source-provided explicit calibration tag, regardless of speed.
negative_control_prescreen.cohort: Restrict to the pre-height frozen 5km-eligible flight 28 biological bird IDs. Never select new birds by their low-motion GPS height outcome.
negative_control_prescreen.date_filter: All source calendar dates in those years, no restrictions by season or previous flight result; 9 original source GPS CSV files.
negative_control_prescreen.time_thinning: FIRST native nonheight-qualified low-motion source event per bird/date/UTC 5-minute bin. Never replace first event based on altitude completeness.
negative_control_prescreen.horizontal_support: Within same 5km cell, at least 10 own OTHER UTC date 5min fixes and 10 different bird OTHER UTC date 5min fixes.
negative_control_prescreen.sensor_quality_metadata: Report HDOP/satellite native source availability WITHOUT filtering to favorable device quality.
negative_control_prescreen.all_source_motion_contexts: Do not compare absolute source-level raw altitude gain to prior flight unless sufficient low-motion matched support; small sample differences have no causal meaning.
negative_control_prescreen.expected_outcome: ONLY ID/day/XY/source-quality support, not altitude mean, distribution, missingness or cross-device residual.

if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.vertical_outcome: Pair native GPS MSL and barometric height columns on identical low-motion GPS fixes after this gate, same ten daily-centered altitude categories and fixed [−500,7000]m, source paired quality >=80%; no outcome-guided fallback.
if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.comparison: Reuse the exact original D1-balanced self-vs-other other-day altitude-shape method, 50 scored native 5min events per day and 2 separate days per bird; 999 whole-date biological bird identity label permutations, min950 valid null per mode.
if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.sensor_family: Holm across exactly GPS and barometric height negative-control outcomes; no additional altitude-grid/class threshold exploration.
if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.interpretation_if_positive: Similarity under low-motion makes tag/terrain and stationarity opportunity explanations more plausible; does NOT show all flight identity is artifact without matching 5km fine paths and device calibration.
if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.interpretation_if_nonpositive: Absence in low-motion does NOT establish genuine flight individuality; speed class, roost opportunity, night-time, sample size and altitude noise differ.
if_admitted_subsequent_exploratory_test.inferential_category: POST-OUTCOME EXPLORATORY, not pre-confirmatory replication: high-speed result and bird-ID strengths were opened before this low-motion study was designed.

no_rescue: No changing source GPS years, speed cutoff from 1m/s, 5km grain, minimum days, height bins or original 28 bird names after inspecting low-motion altitude.
If fewer than 10 low-motion birds pass the preheight same-cell test, report UNAVAILABLE and do not open low-motion height.
Do not call these cases a true behavioral on-ground control without external acceleration/roost proof.
Do not count GPS and barometric columns as physically independent measurement devices without source instrument documentation.
